question: In April 2023,Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty made history, becoming the first Indian men’s doubles pair to win a gold medal at the Badminton Asia Championships. Where was this championship held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dubai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In April 2023, **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty** made history by becoming the first Indian men's doubles pair to win a gold medal at the Badminton Asia Championships.
 
• The championship was held in **Dubai**.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement for Indian badminton, showcasing the nation's growing prowess in the sport.
 
• Rankireddy and Shetty have consistently performed at high levels, and this gold medal is a testament to their hard work and dedication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Badminton Asia Championships is an annual event that gathers the top badminton talents from across the continent.
 
• Dubai has emerged as a prominent host for international sporting events, leveraging its world-class facilities and strategic location.
 
• India's performance in badminton has been on the rise, with several players achieving international success in recent years.
 
• Such victories help in promoting the sport within the country and inspiring the next generation of athletes.
